portfolio.question: G4: does same-direction concentration across legs predict the book's next-24h loss?
portfolio.finding: MEASURED on the BACKTEST population only (8 legs with a committed full-history corpus, 4076 trades, 1090 daily snapshots 2020-06..2026-10, realised-only, week-block bootstrap): NOT supported. Pooled rho(cdir, sum_r) +0.118 CI [0.048, 0.185]; rho(cdir, mean_r) +0.189 [0.126, 0.250]; placebo p05 +0.017: concentration goes with BETTER, not worse, next-24h realised R (a trend-regime co-movement; pooled across families it is a composition effect, within trend rho(sum_r) -0.04 [-0.18, 0.12] n 117, within pullback rho(sum_r) -0.02 [-0.14, 0.10] n 285, both inconclusive). Both reads were taken at authoring BEFORE a rule was written for them, so they are descriptive, not a pre-registered test. The LIVE-journal population (>= 90 d, the G4 check as written) is unread and is the pre-registered test: rule = codirection_drawdown.py grade() as committed.
